Class StorageContainerAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.storage.StorageContainerAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>, net.minecraft.world.Clearable, net.minecraft.world.Container, net.minecraft.world.entity.SlotProvider
public class StorageContainerAdapter extends Object implements net.minecraft.world.Container
Adapts a Storage to vanilla's Container interface. Needed when building slots, because Slot's constructor takes a Container while consumers declare storage through the narrower Storage interface.

CustomContainerMenu uses it for its own slots. Consumers adding slots to vanilla handlers also wrap a Storage in this adapter when calling addSlot with a Slot.

  • Method Details

    • getStorage

      public Storage getStorage()
      Returns the backing Storage. Exposed so internal code (notably ContainerIdentity) can check what kind of storage it is, such as a KeyedStorage, without going through Container. Consumer code should almost always use the Container methods instead.
